mutants.label: [does-nothing] _has_path_filter_key always returns False
mutants.why: Killed by test_detects_a_paths_trigger_key and test_detects_a_paths_ignore_trigger_key: a no-op detector would never flag a real path filter, defeating the whole check.

mutants.label: _PATH_FILTER_KEY_PATTERN drops the paths-ignore alternative
mutants.why: Killed by test_detects_every_yaml_spelling_of_a_path_filter_key[flow-after-comma] and the block paths-ignore cases, and test_detects_a_paths_ignore_trigger_key.

mutants.label: _PATH_FILTER_KEY_PATTERN drops the boundary before the key, matching any substring
mutants.why: Killed by test_does_not_flag_text_that_is_not_a_path_filter_key[key-merely-ending-in-paths]: without a line-start/whitespace/flow boundary, `filepaths:` would false-positive as a trigger key.

mutants.label: _PATH_FILTER_KEY_PATTERN drops the flow-mapping boundary characters
mutants.why: Killed by the flow-mapping-after-brace, flow-after-comma and fully-flow-style spellings: `{paths: [a]}` and `,paths-ignore:` have no whitespace before the key.

mutants.label: _PATH_FILTER_KEY_PATTERN drops the optional quotes around the key
mutants.why: Killed by the double-quoted-key and single-quoted-key spellings.

mutants.label: _has_path_filter_key searches the text without stripping comments first
mutants.why: Killed by test_does_not_flag_text_that_is_not_a_path_filter_key[comment-line], [indented-comment] and [trailing-comment]: `# paths: x` has whitespace before `paths:` so the boundary alone cannot reject it.

mutants.label: [control] reword the module docstring
mutants.why: Module docstring prose; nothing parses or asserts on it, so no test can observe the change on any path.
